verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's marketing docs confirm search (deep-link search feature), service icons, and favoriting/organizing features ('Organize with ease', 'Favorite services to the top', 'Don't scroll'), directly supporting quick access to tokens. However, there is no concrete evidence of folder or group/category organization for large token sets — only vague 'organize with ease' copy and free-text notes (500-char annotations), not structured grouping. Missing for 10: explicit folder/category/tagging feature documentation, evidence of grouping many tokens, independent hands-on confirmation of organization UX at scale.
